correctness.rationale: All 8!=40320 rankings of eight binary 3-mers exhaustively enumerated by a new independent C++17 program implementing leftmost-tie winner-change criterion on all 2^(w+3) iid bit strings for w=2..9. Direct counts produced exactly 1145 distinct (N4,N9) pairs; nondominated pairs (46,759) count48 and (50,750) count32, yielding stated densities /128 and /4096. Individual minima for widths 2..9 were (20,29,46,76,130,229,413,750) with multiplicities (3668,176,48,48,48,48,164,48). Exactly 48 rankings minimize all w=2..8; their first four types are 3206 or 4571 (24 each), and none minimizes w=9. The algorithm enumerates every permutation and every word (exact integer counts), not a Monte Carlo sample; rank shift and tie convention match the result. Only k=3 fair binary inputs and common strict ranking are covered.
